theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 47 群

items.colloc: secure funding 獲得資金 | funding source 資金來源
items.distinct: capital 資本 | budget 預算
ex: The startup is seeking funding for expansion.
這家新創公司正在尋求擴張資金。
Government funding supports this research project.
政府撥款支持這項研究計畫。
We lack sufficient funding to finish the work.
我們缺乏足夠經費來完成工作。

items.colloc: generously donate 慷慨捐贈 | generously support 大方支持
items.distinct: liberally 自由地；慷慨地 | freely 自由地；免費地
ex: The CEO generously donated to the charity.
執行長慷慨地捐款給慈善機構。
They generously offered to cover all expenses.
他們大方地提議負擔所有費用。
Our partner generously shared their marketing data.
我們的合作夥伴大方地分享行銷數據。

items.colloc: industrial zone 工業區 | industrial growth 工業成長
items.distinct: industrious 勤奮的 | manufacturing 製造業的
ex: The site is located in an industrial park.
該地塊位於工業園區內。
New regulations affect many industrial companies.
新規定影響了許多工業公司。
We are analyzing current industrial trends today.
我們今天正在分析當前的工業趨勢。

items.pos: v. 位於；在於（lie 的第三人稱單數）
items.colloc: lie in 在於 | lie within 在...範圍內
items.distinct: lay 放置 | locate 位於（被動用法）
ex: The key to success lies in preparation.
成功的關鍵在於準備。
Our main office lies near the city center.
我們的主辦公室位於市中心附近。
The problem lies with the software update.
問題在於那個軟體更新。

items.pos: v. 舉起；解除（禁令） | n. 電梯（英式）
items.colloc: lift a ban 解除禁令 | lift a restriction 解除限制
items.distinct: elevator 電梯（美式） | hoist 吊起
ex: The committee will lift the trade restrictions.
委員會將解除貿易限制。
Please lift the heavy boxes with care.
請小心地搬起那些重箱子。
Sales figures lifted after the new campaign.
新活動後銷售數據上升了。

items.colloc: take lightly 看輕 | treat lightly 隨便對待
items.distinct: slightly 稍微地 | softly 溫柔地
ex: Do not take the security risks lightly.
不要輕視這些安全風險。
The box should be handled very lightly.
這個箱子應該要輕拿輕放。
Management did not treat the complaint lightly.
管理層並未輕率看待這項投訴。

items.pos: n. 清單；列表 | v. 列出
items.colloc: make a list 列清單 | waiting list 等候名單
items.distinct: inventory 存貨清單 | menu 菜單
ex: Please list all your previous work experience.
請列出你過去所有的工作經驗。
The item is not on the inventory list.
該項目不在庫存清單上。
We added your name to the waiting list.
我們將您的名字加入候補名單了。

items.pos: adj. 整體的 | adv. 大體上
items.colloc: overall performance 整體表現 | overall result 整體結果
items.distinct: generally 通常地 | entirely 完全地
ex: The overall strategy needs to be revised.
整體策略需要進行修訂。
Overall, the project was a great success.
整體而言，這個專案非常成功。
What is the overall cost of this renovation?
這次裝修的總費用是多少？

items.pos: n. 合夥關係；合作關係
items.colloc: form a partnership 建立合作關係 | business partnership 商業夥伴關係
items.distinct: collaboration 合作 | alliance 聯盟
ex: They formed a partnership with a local firm.
他們與當地一家公司建立了合作關係。
Our long-term partnership benefits both sides.
我們的長期合作對雙方都有利。
The company values this strategic partnership.
公司重視這項策略合作夥伴關係。

items.colloc: with pleasure 樂意地 | great pleasure 高興
items.distinct: delight 高興 | enjoyment 享受
ex: It is a pleasure to work with you.
很高興能與您共事。
We had the pleasure of hosting the guest.
我們有幸招待了這位賓客。
My pleasure to assist with your request.
我很樂意協助您的請求。

items.colloc: explore the possibility 探討可能性 | remote possibility 極小的可能性
items.distinct: probability 機率 | opportunity 機會
ex: We are discussing the possibility of merging.
我們正在討論合併的可能性。
There is a possibility of heavy rain tomorrow.
明天有下大雨的可能性。
Please consider every possibility before deciding.
做決定前請考慮每一種可能性。

items.colloc: be presently located 目前位於 | presently unavailable 目前無法使用
items.distinct: currently 目前 | shortly 不久之後
ex: The manager is presently in a meeting.
經理目前正在開會。
We are presently updating our security system.
我們目前正在更新安全系統。
The office is presently closed for repairs.
辦公室目前因維修而關閉。

items.colloc: private sector 私部門 | private property 私人財產
items.distinct: personal 個人的 | public 公共的
ex: The meeting will be held in private.
會議將會私下進行。
He works in the private sector now.
他目前在私人企業工作。
This area is for private use only.
此區域僅供私人使用。

items.pos: n. 程式設計；節目編排
items.colloc: computer programming 電腦程式設計 | television programming 電視節目編排
items.distinct: software 軟體 | scheduling 時程安排
ex: He has a background in computer programming.
他有電腦程式設計的背景。
The channel is changing its evening programming.
該頻道正在調整晚間節目編排。
We need more experts in custom programming.
我們需要更多客製化程式設計的專家。

items.pos: n. 等級；職位 | v. 排名
items.colloc: high rank 高位 | rank among 在...中排名
items.distinct: level 水準 | position 位置
ex: She rose to the rank of director.
她晉升到了主管階級。
The university ranks among the top ten.
這所大學在排名中名列前十。
The survey ranks our service as excellent.
這項調查將我們的服務評為優良。

items.colloc: safety regulation 安全規定 | comply with regulations 遵守法規
items.distinct: rule 規則 | law 法律
ex: Employees must follow the safety regulations.
員工必須遵守安全規定。
New government regulations took effect today.
新的政府法規於今日生效。
We reviewed the regulations regarding imports.
我們審查了關於進口的相關法規。

items.colloc: relax rules 放寬規定 | relax the atmosphere 放鬆氣氛
items.distinct: rest 休息 | loosen 鬆開
ex: You should try to relax after work.
下班後你應該試著放鬆一下。
Management decided to relax the strict policy.
管理層決定放寬這項嚴格的政策。
The team gathered to relax before the project.
團隊在專案開始前聚在一起放鬆。

items.colloc: restore order 恢復秩序 | restore confidence 恢復信心
items.distinct: recover 找回 | repair 修理
ex: The company aims to restore its reputation.
公司目標是恢復其商譽。
Technical staff managed to restore the power.
技術人員設法恢復了電力。
We will restore the building to its state.
我們將把這棟建築恢復原狀。

items.colloc: add spice 增添趣味 | spice up 增添風味
items.distinct: seasoning 調味料 | herb 香草
ex: The recipe calls for a specific spice.
食譜需要一種特殊的香料。
The presentation needs some spice to engage.
簡報需要一些亮點來吸引聽眾。
We export high-quality spice to overseas markets.
我們將優質香料出口到海外市場。

items.colloc: sufficiently trained 受過充分訓練 | sufficiently prepared 準備充足
items.distinct: adequately 足夠地 | fully 完全地
ex: The staff is sufficiently trained for this task.
員工已為此項任務接受充分訓練。
Is the budget sufficiently funded for growth?
預算對於成長來說足夠充裕嗎？
The document was not sufficiently detailed.
這份文件細節不夠充分。
